title: Laredo College Earns National QEP Excellence Award for Student Success
excerpt: Laredo College was named one of 17 recipients of the inaugural Quality Enhancement Plan Project of Excellence Awards from The Commission on Colleges and Universities, for its “Digital Connections” plan bringing digital learning tools into gatekeeper courses.
content:
Laredo College has earned national recognition for advancing student success, named one of 17 recipients of the inaugural Quality Enhancement Plan (QEP) Project of Excellence Awards from The Commission on Colleges and Universities.

The new awards recognize institutions whose Quality Enhancement Plans made a measurable difference in student learning, student success, or both.

Laredo College received the recognition for its Quality Enhancement Plan, “Digital Connections: Bridging Learning and Technology,” which focused on the purposeful integration of digital learning technologies in gatekeeper courses — the foundational courses students must pass early to stay on track toward a degree.

Laredo College was one of 17 institutions nationwide selected for the first round of the awards, alongside community and technical colleges, public and private universities, and Hispanic-serving institutions. The Commission will recognize all 17 winners at its Annual Meeting, Dec. 5–8, 2026, in Houston, Texas.

Sources: The Commission on Colleges and Universities — “The Commission Recognizes 17 Institutions as Winners of Inaugural QEP Project of Excellence Awards”, https://commissioncu.org/the-commission-recognizes-17-institutions-as-winners-of-inaugural-qep-project-of-excellence-awards/
